name: testwright
description: Testing for real application code across C#/.NET, Unity, TypeScript/npm, Python and Roblox Luau: risk-first test plan, one run summary across runners (failures, flaky reruns, slow tests, changed-line coverage), suite quality (mutation testing, assertions that never fail, tests that only check mocks), characterization tests for legacy code, and game tests (play mode, input, seed replays, save/load round trips, bot playthroughs). Not for browser end-to-end tests or skill evals.
